title: Marvell Technology reports Q2 FY27 earnings after the close
summary: Marvell Technology is scheduled to release fiscal second-quarter 2027 results after the U.S. close on Aug. 27, with analysts estimating non-GAAP earnings per share of about 0.93 dollars, up 39 percent year over year, on roughly 2.71 billion dollars in revenue. The print comes roughly a week after Marvell disclosed a 7 percent warrant to Google tied to the custom AI silicon work the chipmaker is doing around Google's Tensor Processing Unit program.
